- Primary keyword "water heater services in Queen Creek"; supporting terms such as hot water heater service, water heater company, tankless water heater services.
- GEO entities: Southwest Gas; Encanterra, Ironwood Crossing, Harvest, Cortina, Hastings Farms, San Tan Heights; Riggs and Combs Road; brands Rheem, A.O. Smith, Bradford White, Navien, Rinnai, Bosch, State; 2003 to 2012 first-build cohort.
- 7-question FAQ; Service + Plumber + areaServed schema.
- Structure mirrors Chandler with a $50 off coupon block; links to `/water-heaters/`, `/contact/`, tankless Queen Creek and 2 to 3 nearby cities.
- Note: the draft cites a "10 to 12 year service life"; under the no-overpromising rule any lifespan claim needs a source before publishing.
- The live page (ID 5772) shows a 2026-06-17 post date in `_sheet\pages_live.csv`; staged files are in [Summit AZ - WP Staging Pages](lib:brain-summit-az-wp-staging-pages).
